_doc.language_name: name of the language, in English, written into the LLM prompt (llm_prompt_builder.py)
_doc.fillers: filler sounds cut wherever they stand, confidence 0.95 (mechanical_cuts.py); a word listed here AND in sentence_start_fillers is cut everywhere
_doc.sentence_start_fillers: fillers cut (confidence 0.85) only after a pause of 0.4 s or more, i.e. at the start of a sentence (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.false_start_triggers: normalized phrases (lowercase, no punctuation) that open a window for the semantic analysis, never cut by themselves (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.slate_patterns: regexes searched in the normalized text of the first 15 s: a match cuts everything up to the word after it (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.stop_words: words that do not count as content: a repeated n-gram made only of them (or of words under 3 letters) drops to confidence 0.55 (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.correction_openers: a sentence starting with one of these, right after a similar one, is read as a correction and lowers the rephrasing threshold (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.word_chars: extra characters kept by normalize_word on top of \w, apostrophe and hyphen (mechanical_cuts.py)
_doc.token_break_punct: a whisper token starting with one of these starts a new word (transcribe.py)
_doc.orphan_connectors: short connectors that, isolated right before a cut silence, are cut with it (reference list for the take selection in context, not read by the scripts)
_doc.openers: openers cut at the start of a sentence (reference list for the take selection in context, not read by the scripts)
_doc.whisper_hallucinations: lines whisper invents over silence: hear.py printing one means there is no word in the slice (reference list, not read by the scripts)
_doc.prompt_examples: speech examples quoted in the semantic-analysis prompt (llm_prompt_builder.py)
_doc.reasons: texts written into the reason field of the cuts (shown in the red markers and the reports), with the language's typography; {name} and {name:.2f} are filled by the scripts

prompt_examples.immediate_repetition: I wanted... I wanted to tell you
prompt_examples.rhetorical_repetition: no, no, no, that's not true
prompt_examples.reason: Sentence started then rephrased, marker 'wait no let me start again' at 47.5
prompt_examples.matched_text: So today I'm going to... wait no let me start again
prompt_examples.context_after: Today I'm going to talk about

reasons.slate: Take slate at the start of the clip
reasons.silence_noisy: Silence {gap:.1f}s, {noise:.1f}s of noise detected (laugh? handling?), check before cutting
reasons.clip_end: End of the clip after the last sentence
reasons.clip_start: Start of the clip before the first sentence
reasons.isolated_sound_head: Isolated {duration:.2f} s sound at the head of the clip, after a gap: leftover of a failed take or an intended word? Keep it or not
reasons.isolated_sound_tail: Isolated {duration:.2f} s sound at the tail of the clip, after a gap: leftover of a failed take or an intended word? Keep it or not
